_note: Echo runs (VARIETY_PLAN V6). Once the rider is past a zone's top level and has beaten its boss, the zone offers a hunt at the rider's level. Enemies keep their art, moves and elements but take their stats from the matching enemy of a zone tuned for the rider's level (regular by position, mini-boss, boss). XP and gold from echo fights are multiplied by these. scale: control points [level, multiplier] for an echo enemy's HP and attack, by the level it is fought at, interpolated between points. Fitted with npm run sim -- --echo. zones: an extra multiplier for one zone's echoes, for zones whose elements make them easier or harder than the curve.
